title: Travel-Issue Nightly Refund Computation: Affected Nights and Amount
content:
# Travel-issue nightly refund — guest care computation standard

**Clause.** On an approved travel issue on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the affected nights are the stay's nights dated on or after the date the travel issue was submitted and before the check-out date, and one night's price is the nightly subtotal divided by the stay's nights, rounded half up to the cent. The travel-issue nightly refund is the price of every affected night, refunded in full — at 100 percent of each affected night's price — and paid to the guest's card in full, rounded half up to the cent once.

## Definitions

- **The travel issue** — the stay's approved travel-issue request; where the stay has more than one approved, the one decided most recently.
- **Date submitted** — the date part of that request's submission time. A request submitted before the check-in date makes every night of the stay affected.
- **Nightly subtotal and nights** — those in the stay's price breakdown.

## Worked figure (hypothetical stay)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Nights | 7, check-in on day D |
| Nightly subtotal | 1,050.00 |
| Night price | 1,050.00 divided by 7, that is 150.00 |
| Request submitted | on D plus 2 (the third night) |
| Affected nights | the nights dated D plus 2 through D plus 6: 5 nights |
| Nightly refund | 5 times 150.00 at 100 percent: 750.00 |

The same request submitted on D plus 6, the last night, affects 1 night and refunds 150.00.
